headline: RSI: Light Keyboard Week — Job Search 7 Days Stale ⚠️
summary: Monday = ease back gently after zero-keyboard weekend. Job search now 7 days stale — LinkedIn check-in today breaks the streak. 16 days to Vancouver wedding. Micro-learning: double-type rule = prevent RSI before the trip.

micro_learning.insight: Every task you type twice is a task you should have delegated or automated. The RSI risk isn't from big typing sessions — it's from micro-repetitions adding up across weeks. Track your 'double-types' for just one day and you'll find 5–10.
micro_learning.action: Build a personal rule: If I type the same phrase or command more than twice, I set up a script/snippet or delegate it to Hermes. This week, catch your double-types — 16 days to Vancouver means your wrists need headroom for wedding-week typing.
micro_learning.why: 16 days until Vancouver. The average wedding week involves 3–4x normal typing (itineraries, group chats, confirmations). Your wrists need reserve capacity.

today_builds: Clean slate: 3 previously failing crons paused — system stability from May 7
Pending: Telegram session May 5 09:55 with unanswered message — needs manual review
rsi: Monday = light keyboard day after zero-keyboard weekend. Ease back gently. Rule for the week: Every email that can be sent via voice or Hermes delegation, do that instead. 16 days before Vancouver — wrists are rebuilding, don't undo 48 hours of recovery in one morning.

job_search.action: LinkedIn check-in TODAY or tomorrow — even 10 minutes breaks the streak. Post, react to posts, or update your headline. 7 days stale = search going cold. Also: any recruiter from past 2 weeks? Send a one-line follow-up.
